purpose: Pinned sources for the Fuse-X LVGL port and separate graphics investigations

lvgl.license: MIT; see LICENCE.txt in the unmodified archive
lvgl.extraction: src, include, lvgl.h, lv_conf_template.h, README.md, LICENCE.txt under the ignored build directory
lvgl.adaptation: Generated C16 RGB888/A8 profile and checked source adaptations in adapt.py; pristine archive and source tree are retained separately. See build/lvgl/adaptation.json.

xserver.license: See COPYING and per-file notices in the official source archive
xserver.extraction: Selected unmodified build files and headers for dependency and backend inspection only

xml_reference.usage: Read-only dependency inspection. No XML loader source imported or built.

noto_sans.generator: fonts/generate.py (build-time Pillow/FreeType; no guest rasterizer dependency)
noto_sans.bitmap_storage: Static A8 masks; identical glyph images are interned within each size

lucide_icons.license: ISC plus Feather-derived MIT notice; icons/LICENSE.Lucide.txt
lucide_icons.representation: 21 named A8 masks at 16/32 pixels; arrow-up is a clockwise quarter-turn of arrow-left
lucide_icons.generation: Maintainer-only sharp/librsvg supersampling; ordinary builds verify checked-in masks and sources

font_awesome_checkmark.license: OFL-1.1; LICENSE.FontAwesome5.txt from the pinned LVGL archive
font_awesome_checkmark.representation: Static A8 masks expanded exactly from the original 4-bit glyphs
